## What changed

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## How it was verified

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] Relevant failure, stale-state, and external-change paths were tested
- [ ] UI changes were checked with keyboard navigation, reduced motion, and narrow and wide windows

List any focused checks or explain what could not be run.

## Product and safety review

- [ ] The change preserves comments, unknown settings, source structure, and unrelated config content
- [ ] The webview receives no new general-purpose file, shell, process, or network access
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese copy are both updated and remain concise
- [ ] Screenshots, recordings, logs, fixtures, and examples contain only synthetic or fully redacted data
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, accessibility, and rollback behavior were considered where relevant
- [ ] Architecture, threat-model, or product documentation is updated if a contract changed

## Notes for reviewers

Call out compatibility assumptions, security-sensitive boundaries, or follow-up work. Remove checklist
items that genuinely do not apply and say why.
